name: Stormbringer Air Elemental casts from range without moving (#12871)
contract: #12871: the Air Elemental only played its cast animation in melee range and crept toward the target on every
cast. The PR author's review of original Ascension footage shows it never moves while casting, unshackled or
not. Its attack is Windpelt 806016, a 2 s cast with medium range that movement interrupts, but native PetAI
kept a ranged chase only for the Imp and the Water Elemental, so the Air Elemental always chased into melee.
With Windpelt on autocast it now chases only to Windpelt's maximum range. The target stands 20 yards from
the stationary Stormbringer, inside that range: the pet starts beside its owner, must cast Windpelt, and
must stay within 6 yards of its owner, both normally and after Unshackle 706625. Chasing into melee would
put it near 20. Turning Windpelt autocast off mid-fight must reissue the active chase at melee range, so the
pet leaves its owner and closes on the target (more than 14 yards from the owner).
